notes.title: Happy Pride Month !
notes.content:
Celebrate Pride Month with us!
40% off on all Potico Games to celebrate queerness and diversity.
We want to send a clear message that we care and kindness between us should prevail in the fight for our rights
Be proud and shine your rainbow bright! Happy Pride Month to all

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.3 January 24, 2025
notes.content:
Changes:

[list]
[*] DeFacto: add a tutorial to teach basic building of a factory
[*] DeFacto: money flow value (per second, displayed at top left) now only include seller's and rocket's money
[*] DeFacto: slight redesign of recipe menu to be more clear
[*] PCraft: now timer only starts with first input
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.0.2 January 19, 2025
notes.content:
New features:
[list]
[*] Save slot: you can now clear a save slot from the option menu
[*] P.Craft: you can continue playing your save after a successful escape
[*] P.Craft: the monster now issues a warning so you know to come prepared
[*] P.Craft: a timer can be displayed in game (toggle in pause menu)
[*] P.Craft: seeded mode, so you can share interesting worlds
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] P.Craft: resetting the game know brings you back to the game's title screen
[*] P.Craft: you can now longer drop a bench on top of another one
[/list]

notes.title: Unleash Your Inner Engineer with DeFacto!
notes.content:
The final game in the PicoMix by Nusan compilation, DeFacto, lets you build an automated factory on a distant asteroid, sending rockets into space to explore the galaxy.

 Collect raw materials, process them into products, and build massive chains of factories to achieve your goal. DeFacto is perfect for fans of complex simulation and strategy games.

That concludes the PicoMix by Nusan reveals—stay tuned for more surprises in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288574/08edf10712823358bf9d03eac42e7d6199cccc8d.gif[/img]

notes.title: Solve Mystical Puzzles in Path of Aratron – Coming Soon to PicoMix by Nusan!
notes.content:
Step into a world of magic and logic in Path of Aratron.

This puzzle game combines esoteric programming with clever puzzle design as you control a little demon on a journey through dreams. Place stones on glyphs and watch as the summoning ritual unfolds.

With 25 increasingly difficult puzzles to solve, this Ludum Dare 55 entry is sure to challenge your mind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288574/932954bc8484ebb35fabce3c2fbe168db3a3d676.gif[/img]

notes.title: Meet Zebulon – New Game in PicoMix by Nusan!
notes.content:
Zebulon is lost in a mysterious world, but with your help, this brave cat will overcome every challenge.

Explore a tiny 2D platformer with Metroidvania mechanics, uncovering Zebulon’s powers and using your skills to navigate tricky environments. Zebulon was a fan favorite upon its release, and we’re excited to bring this adventurous game back in our compilation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288574/2c9103cd0eb5d92fe7a2858157f06044c091dc8d.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more exciting announcements next week!

notes.title: Time to Survive in P.Craft Deluxe – Another Game in PicoMix by Nusan!
notes.content:
P.Craft Deluxe drops you on a deserted island where you must gather materials, build tools, and explore in order to survive.

With its permadeath system, every choice matters, and exploring the island’s mysterious cave could be your key to escape. Originally released in 2016 and expanded in 2017, P.Craft Deluxe remains a tense and rewarding experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288574/7f83b717f355f18d1ef3a08a9ede3c2479c20914.gif[/img]

Don’t miss the next game reveal next week !

notes.title: Introducing Dami & Flo: A Fun Delivery Puzzle!
notes.content:
The fifth game in the PicoMix by Nusan compilation, Dami & Flo, takes you aboard a busy delivery train.

Your job? Organize and manage packages across multiple stops, trying to keep up with requests as they come in. Whether solo or in split-screen mode with a friend, you’ll need to sort and store packages in the wagons quickly to avoid chaos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288574/818a2112b6fdecf5aa8c3e030b22062e27adb64b.gif[/img]

Released during a "Secret Santa" game jam in 2021, this charming puzzle game will keep you on your toes!

notes.title: Fourth Game in PicoMix by Nusan: Flooded Caves!
notes.content:
Dive into Flooded Caves, where every second counts.

In this action-packed game jam entry from Ludum Dare 50, you must dig strategically to control the rising waters and save your team. With limited digging power that recharges over time, careful planning is key. Can you save everyone before the inevitable flood takes over?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288574/b216303ac04615c72375e282af58de074ca1e093.gif[/img]

Next game announcement is just around the corner—don’t miss it next week!

notes.title: Announcing Cyclo 8 – The third Game in the PicoMix by Nusan Compilation!
notes.content:
Get ready for a wild ride! Cyclo 8, the third game in the PicoMix by Nusan compilation, brings back retro physics-based biking fun.

Released in 2015 as Nusan's very first Pico 8 game, it features 7 levels of increasing difficulty, time trials, and plenty of tricky jumps to master. Can you collect all the items without falling?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288574/5c352e956ede95e84f9d7fe65f501f2d1b57e58a.gif[/img]

Check back next week for the next announcement!

notes.title: Unveil the second Game in PicoMix By Nusan: Combo Pool!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the second game in our upcoming PicoMix by Nusan compilation, Combo Pool! 

This arcade puzzle game will challenge your reflexes and strategic thinking as you throw marbles to create colorful chain reactions. Originally made in just seven days for Lexaloffle’s Pico 8 game jam in 2016, where it won first place, Combo Pool continues to captivate with its addictive mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288574/b8db4b926fc1b4893e3d5c5de93783428ec6ebdb.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for the next game announcement next week!
